column1: # Two seven-turn threads per language that change *what kind of question* they are asking.
# `conversations_deep.tsv` keeps one shape per thread and varies the subject. These do the
# opposite: the subject stays put and the question shape moves — a list becomes a superlative
# becomes a lookup becomes a comparison becomes a margin becomes a safety question. That is where a
# dialogue state leaks, because each hop has to hand on a *different* slot than the one before it.
# Thread F — list, then its extreme member, then that member's value, then a second element, then
#   the two compared, then the size of the difference, then a safety question about the one that
#   was named rather than the one in focus.
# Thread H — one element in three units, then a second element, then which wins, then a question
#   with no field at all (isotopes), then back to a field. Turn 2 and 3 carry a unit and nothing
#   else; turn 6 abandons the field the thread has been about; turn 7 has to still know the subject.
# Element names, including Filipino "Plurin" and Urdu "آزمیم", come from elements_<lang>.json.
